messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High tail latency observed in runtime pool rt-us-west-2. Alerting policy: runtime_latency_p95 > 600ms for 3m. Paging primary and secondary oncall.
Emma (oncall): seeing it, digging into dashboards. switching to my laptop.
Raj (primary): I can take lead, Emma you good to stay secondary?
Emma (oncall): yep staying on deck. tagging infra + security for routing Qs.
Mike: is this customer-facing errors or internal queueing? any 5xx?
Emma (oncall): so far 200s but high token generation times. Console shows spikes on model shards >90% util.
Isabelle: can you paste the agent logs / profiling window?
Emma (oncall): pasting snippet: ```
2023-11-03T14:01:12Z runtime: batch_latency_ms=820 shard=rt-uw2-12 model=gptx-lr quant=fp16
2023-11-03T14:01:13Z cache: miss prefix_ratio=0.82
2023-11-03T14:01:14Z scheduler: queued_requests=42
```
Raj (primary): that looks like a KV cache miss storm + scheduling backlog. probable evictions after a model rollout?
Isabelle: any recent kernel updates or infra autoscale changes?
Emma (oncall): infra autoscaler shows no recent scale-up events. config last changed by deploy-bot 2h ago (canary model-variant rollout).
Support-Oncall: we got one inbound support ticket complaining about slow responses from a customer in APAC, marked severity=high.
Sec-Oncall: any signs of malicious traffic or spikes from odd IPs? I'm checking WAF patterns.
Mike: quick check: routing question — if it's model cache / runtime, who owns mitigation and paged rotations? runtime team handles model-serving mitigations; infra handles autoscaling and node-level issues; security handles weird traffic. we need explicit handoff.
Raj (primary): agreed. Emma and I will lead runtime mitigation (cache/kvcfg rollback). Isabelle, can infra look at adding temporary burst capacity in the us-west pool?
Isabelle: on it. ETA 8m to spin up warm nodes if autoscaler allows. if not, I can force a scale but need approval.
Sec-Oncall: WAF shows elevated rate from a handful of IPs but within allowed thresholds. not blocked yet. won't be root cause unless combined with a cache-miss pattern.
Emma (oncall): runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-high-latency — follow section "emergency rollback of model-variant" first. quoting snippet: ```rollback: set model_variant_active=false; wait 30s; observe p95```. 
Raj (primary): I'll attempt rollback on canary 3 -> previous stable. Emma please watch KMV metrics and heatmap. Isabelle please start 2 warm nodes if possible. Mike, keep support loop updated.
Mike: will update support & customer-facing slack thread. prepping canned FAQ: "We're investigating elevated response times; no request failures reported. We're mitigating now." 
Emma (oncall): executing rollback now. ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/rollouts/variants/canary3/rollback -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
incident-bot: Rollback job started (job id rj_8492). status: running.
Emma (oncall): p95 backdown to ~250ms after 45s. still watching.
Isabelle: forced 2 warm nodes up; see capacity increase on pool rt-us-west-2.
Sec-Oncall: continuing to monitor WAF; nothing anomalous after scale.
Raj (primary): looks stable. Emma, please prepare a short post-incident note summarizing timeline + root cause hypothesis (model variant canary + cache miss + insufficient warm nodes). Also note on-call handoff: I'm wrapping primary, Emma you'll be primary for the next shift?
Emma (oncall): I can take next shift starting in 45m. Raj please log the handoff in #oncall-handoffs.
Raj (primary): logged handoff: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/1746500000 — contains tasks, current mitigating actions, and followups: investigate canary config, extend warm node policy, add cache-miss threshold alert.
Mike: customer update posted. support ticket updated with mitigation and ETA for root cause review.
Isabelle: infra followup: propose autoscaler change to prefer warm nodes preemptively for model-serving pools. will PR.
Sec-Oncall: I'll run a deeper traffic analysis overnight. no immediate sec action.
Emma (oncall): thanks team. final check: p95=230ms, queued_requests=3, cache_miss_ratio=0.12. moving to monitoring.
Raj (primary): closing pager. Emma you're primary. Handed off at 1746500123. :white_check_mark:
Mike: :thumbsup:
Isabelle: glhf rest of shift.
Sec-Oncall: night watch on traffic anomalies.
Emma (oncall): copying runbook pointers for whoever comes after me: 1) runtime runbook (link above), 2) infra autoscaler playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscale, 3) incident-retro template: https://redwood.internal/incident-retro.
Raj (primary): thanks everyone.
